title: Terms of use
summary: These terms explain how you may use thaivisaexperts.com. In short, the site gives general information only, you use it at your own risk, and you should always confirm the rules with official Thai sources before you act.
seoDescription: The terms for using Thai Visa Experts: information only, no legal advice, limits of liability, external links and intellectual property.

sections.heading: Agreeing to these terms
paragraphs: By using thaivisaexperts.com ("the site") you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the site. We may update the terms from time to time; the version on this page applies from the date it is published.

sections.heading: Information only, not advice
paragraphs: The site gives general information about Thai visas, entry rules and related topics. It is not legal, immigration, tax or financial advice, and reading it does not create a lawyer-client or any other professional relationship.

We are an independent information service. We are not the Royal Thai Government, the Immigration Bureau or a Thai embassy, and we cannot grant, guarantee or speed up any visa. Decisions are made only by the Thai authorities, who may apply the rules differently in individual cases.

Thai rules change often. We work hard to keep pages accurate and show when each one was last verified, but we can't promise that every page is complete, current or right for your situation. Always check with the official sources and, for complex cases, a qualified professional before you apply, book travel or make other decisions.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: The site is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind. To the fullest extent the law allows, we are not liable for any loss or damage arising from your use of, or reliance on, the site. This includes refused visas or entry, travel costs, fines, overstays, lost income or any indirect or consequential loss.
Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law, such as liability for fraud or, where applicable, your statutory rights as a consumer.

sections.heading: External links
paragraphs: We link to official government websites and other third-party sites so you can check information at the source. We don't control those sites and aren't responsible for their content, availability, privacy practices or fees. A link is not an endorsement.
Be careful with unofficial sites that imitate government services. Official Thai government sites end in .go.th.

You may read, print and share links to our pages for personal, non-commercial use. You may quote short extracts if you credit Thai Visa Experts and link to the original page. You may not copy, republish, sell or systematically scrape the content, or present it as your own, without our written permission.
Names such as "Destination Thailand Visa", "LTR", "SMART" and "Thailand Privilege" belong to their respective government bodies or owners, and we use them only to describe their programmes.

paragraphs: Please don't misuse the site: don't try to break or overload it, gain unauthorised access, or use it for anything unlawful.
